title: 美银Helen Qiao：出口明年放缓至10%，刺激为何还要等？
speaker: Helen Qiao

segments.en: I think going into 2027, that's indeed, I would say that a largely widespread kind of consensus where people are expecting China's exports
segments.zh: 我认为进入2027年，这确实是一个广泛共识，人们预期中国出口

segments.en: to slow down somewhat. The deceleration may not be too drastic, however.
segments.zh: 会有所放缓。不过减速可能不会太剧烈。

segments.en: We're not talking about growth going from 30% to minus 30%.
segments.zh: 我们说的不是增速从30%降到负30%。

segments.en: We're talking about probably 30% to 10%, on average next year.
segments.zh: 我们说的是明年平均可能从30%降到10%。

segments.en: So we are seeing the potential deceleration, but at the same time, I am afraid that, you know, that reinforces what we just argued.
segments.zh: 所以我们看到潜在放缓，但同时，我担心这印证了我们刚才的论点。

segments.en: If export is going to slow down much more next year, why should I put in more stimulus now?
segments.zh: 如果明年出口放缓更多，为什么我现在要加大刺激？

segments.en: We should probably wait until when it is needed the most.
segments.zh: 我们或许应该等到最需要的时候。

segments.zh: 当然，在深圳有一个重要会议，
